description: Life should be fun and enjoyable. We can only control our internal worlds 🤍 #PersonalGrowth #SelfMastery #InnerWork
transcript: I live a life of enjoyment and fun. I do not live a heavy life. I do not carry more than I need to. I do not put more weight on myself than necessary. There is no award for being the most overworked or the saddest. I live a life where I can explore through happiness. I do not want to live in a space where I'm constantly cautious about everything going on around me. I don't live like that. I live with fun at the forefront.
